Refund policy

We want every customer to feel confident when they subscribe. This page explains when a refund is available, how to ask for one, and how long it takes for the money to appear on your statement once we approve the request.

Eligibility

A full refund is available within thirty days of the first payment. After that window, we refund the unused part of an annual plan on a prorated basis. Refunds are not available for one-off onboarding work, because that work cannot be returned.

If your account was charged after you cancelled, the charge is always refunded in full, whatever the date. Contact support with the invoice number and we will confirm the reversal within one business day.

How to request a refund

  1. Open the billing page of your workspace.
  2. Choose the invoice you want refunded.
  3. Select "Request a refund" and tell us why.

We answer every request within two business days. Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method; banks usually take five to ten business days to show the credit.
